description: Punctuality of Eurostar - London Route trains is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly punctuality of Eurostar - London Route trains on the Infrabel network. From 1 October 2023, the Thalys brand will be replaced by the Eurostar brand. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers, Eurostar, Hogesnelheidstreinen. The portal shows 128 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
